A clean and modern UI design for a food delivery mobile application, presented on two smartphone screens. The first screen is a home page with a "Food Offer" header, a search bar with a filter icon, a large banner for "Delicious Savings 30% Off" featuring a burger, category chips for All, Burger, Pizza and Sushi, and a list of dishes with photos, delivery times and heart icons. The second screen is the cart: a delivery location, the selected items with quantity controls, a promo code field, a price breakdown with subtotal, delivery, discount and total, and a yellow Checkout button. Rounded corners, a light colour palette with yellow accents, high-quality food photography.
Courier tracking for a grocery delivery app: live map with the courier's route to my address and an ETA sheet, order details, and a chat with the courier. Dark theme.
Yoga mashg'ulotlari ilovasi, 3 ta ekran: bugungi mashg'ulot, mashg'ulot tafsilotlari va progress. Yashil rang, yumaloq burchaklar.

A calm sleep and wind-down app: tonight's bedtime ring with a big hours-slept number, a gentle sleep sound library with soft gradients, a weekly sleep chart, and a morning check-in. Warm dark palette, generous space, one serif headline per screen.

Specialty coffee ordering for one roaster: a hero drink with a full-bleed photo, a menu of drinks with size and milk options, a cart with a clear total, and an order tracking screen with a friendly progress. Cream and espresso tones, editorial type.

A minimalist personal wallet: balance as the hero figure, a bento of spending tiles, a transaction list grouped by day, a card detail with a soft-3D card, and a send-money flow. Ink black and one electric accent, tabular numerals everywhere.

Plant care companion: a garden overview with photo tiles, a plant detail with watering schedule and light needs, a reminder list, and a diary with photos. Botanical greens on warm cream, hand-made feel without being childish.

A running club app: today's run as a hero with distance in huge type and a route map, a weekly training plan, a run detail with pace splits, and a club leaderboard. Bold, energetic, high contrast, dark surfaces with a neon accent.

A long-form reading app: a home feed with editorial covers, an article view with beautiful typography and a reading progress ring, a saved list, and a profile with reading stats. Paper white, one serif display face, quiet chrome.

A weekend trip planner: a trip cover with a full-width photo and countdown, an itinerary timeline by day, a place detail with map and photos, and a packing checklist. Sun-bleached palette, big photos, soft glass over imagery.

A focus timer for deep work: a full-screen session timer with a huge number and a thick ring, a session history with a heatmap, a task list for the session, and settings for sounds. Dark, focused, one vivid accent, no clutter.
